errors.text: The proposed BCC/B2 refractory HEA is the wrong material family and initial microstructure; the target is an as-cast AlCoCrFeNi2.1 eutectic HEA containing FCC and B2 phases.

The hypothesis changes the transition variable from aging temperature to aging time and therefore does not reconstruct the approximately 550–750 °C brittle window or the 600 °C minimum and 750 °C recovery.
The cited evidence does not establish the required prior evidence of temperature-dependent L12 chemical ordering in FCC domains, elevated APBE, or jagged B2/FCC phase-boundary evolution.

The proposed recovery through a continuous brittle-phase network is speculative and is extrapolated from a different alloy tested in as-cast compression rather than from aging-induced tensile ductility recovery.
A fixed-temperature time-series experiment cannot directly falsify the target hypothesis of a non-monotonic temperature-dependent ductile-brittle-ductile transition.
